name: weakpoint passive
note:
<JS Post-Damage as User>
if (!target || value <= 0 || !user) return;

const markStates = [147, 148, 149, 150, 151, 152];
const currentMark = markStates.find(id => target.isStateAffected(id));
const currentIndex = markStates.indexOf(currentMark);

const skill = this.item();
const skillId = skill?.id;

// Fonction pour nettoyer toutes les marques
const clearAllMarks = () => {
  markStates.forEach(id => target.removeState(id));
  target.refresh();
};

// Si la cible n’a aucune marque
if (currentMark == null) {
  target.addState(markStates[0]);
  target.refresh();
}
// Si elle a entre Lv1 et Lv5
else if (currentIndex >= 0 && currentIndex < markStates.length - 1) {
  target.removeState(currentMark);
  target.addState(markStates[currentIndex + 1]);
  target.refresh();
}
// Si elle est déjà à Marque Max
else if (currentIndex === markStates.length - 1) {
  if(target.isAlive()) {
    const bonus = Math.floor((user.atk * 2.5) * (1+((target.mhp - target.hp)/target.mhp))); 
    
    setTimeout(() => {
        target._lastAttacker = user;
        target.gainHp(-bonus);
        target.startDamagePopup();
        if (target._markDmg != null) {
          target._markDmg += bonus;
        }
        $gameTemp.requestAnimation([target], 2); // animation bonus
        clearAllMarks(); // retire les marques
        target.refresh();
        //Basic Attack Trigger
        if (skillId === 1) {
            user.addState(323); 
            user.refresh();
        }
        //EX Trigger
        if (skillId === 334) {
            user.addState(154);
            user.refresh();
        }
        //S1 Trigger
        if (skillId === 335) {
            user.gainTp(25);
            user.refresh();
        }
        //S2 Trigger
        if (skillId === 336) {
            user.addBuff(2, 3);
            user.refresh();
        }
        if (target.isDead()) {
        target.performCollapse();
        }
      }, 10); // 300 ms = assez pour séparer proprement les popups
  }
}
</JS Post-Damage as User>

<Category: buff>
<JS Pre-Damage as Target>
$gameTemp._spiritLinkLock ??= 0;
if ($gameTemp._spiritLinkLock > 0) return;

// dégâts uniquement (pas les soins)
if (typeof value !== "number" || value <= 0) return;

if (!target?.isActor?.()) return;

const partnerId = Number(target._spiritLinkPartnerId || 0);
if (!partnerId) return;

const partner = $gameActors.actor(partnerId);
if (!partner) return;

// lien réciproque minimal (ne dépend PAS des states, car ils peuvent sauter à la mort)
if (Number(partner._spiritLinkPartnerId || 0) !== target.actorId()) return;

// si le partenaire est déjà mort, ne split pas (sinon ça part dans le vide)
if (partner.isDead()) return;

const share = Math.floor(value / 2);
if (share <= 0) return;

// stocke pour Post-Damage (sur la cible touchée)
target._spiritLinkPendingShare = share;
target._spiritLinkPendingPartnerId = partnerId;

// la cible ne prend que l'autre moitié → popup dégâts correct
value = value - share;
</JS Pre-Damage as Target>

<JS Post-Damage as Target>
$gameTemp._spiritLinkLock ??= 0;
if ($gameTemp._spiritLinkLock > 0) return;

if (!target?.isActor?.()) return;

const share = Number(target._spiritLinkPendingShare || 0);
const partnerId = Number(target._spiritLinkPendingPartnerId || 0);

// nettoyage immédiat (AoE/multi-hit)
target._spiritLinkPendingShare = 0;
target._spiritLinkPendingPartnerId = 0;

if (share <= 0 || !partnerId) return;

const partner = $gameActors.actor(partnerId);
if (!partner) return;

$gameTemp._spiritLinkLock++;

// 1) Transfert de dégâts au partenaire (si vivant)
if (partner.hp > 0) {
  partner.gainHp(-share);

  // popup dégâts
  partner.startDamagePopup();
  partner.performDamage();
  partner.requestEffect("damage");
}

// 2) Mort liée - version robuste
// Ici, HP sont déjà à jour, donc c'est LE bon endroit.
if (target.hp <= 0 || partner.hp <= 0) {
  // die() est plus fiable que addState(1)
  if (target.hp > 0) target.die();
  if (partner.hp > 0) partner.die();

  // au cas où l’un était déjà à 0 mais pas "dead" côté état interne
  target.refresh();
  partner.refresh();

  // optionnel visuel
  target.requestEffect("collapse");
  partner.requestEffect("collapse");
}

$gameTemp._spiritLinkLock--;
</JS Post-Damage as Target>

$gameTemp._spiritLinkEraseLock ??= 0;

// cleanup local

target._spiritLinkPendingPartnerId = 0;

if (!partner) return;

// seulement si lien réciproque
if (Number(partner._spiritLinkPartnerId || 0) !== target.actorId()) return;

$gameTemp._spiritLinkEraseLock++;
partner._spiritLinkPartnerId = 0;
partner._spiritLinkPendingShare = 0;

partner.removeState(266);
partner.removeState(267);
$gameTemp._spiritLinkEraseLock--;

target._spiritLinkPendingShare = 0;
target._spiritLinkPendingPartnerId = 0;

if (!partnerId) return;

const partner = $gameActors.actor(partnerId);
if (!partner) return;

if (Number(partner._spiritLinkPartnerId || 0) !== target.actorId()) return;

$gameTemp._spiritLinkEraseLock++;
partner._spiritLinkPartnerId = 0;
partner._spiritLinkPendingShare = 0;
partner._spiritLinkPendingPartnerId = 0;
partner.removeState(266);
partner.removeState(267);
$gameTemp._spiritLinkEraseLock--;
</JS On Expire State>
